description: One Italian region (slug such as abruzzo or friuli-venezia-giulia, or its name): population, foreign residents by citizenship (citizenship, not birthplace), `seismicZones` (a count of its comuni per official seismic zone, never an average), the region-grain map layers (healthcare scores), its provinces (look each up with get_province) and how much of the region meets each verified tax regime (places, not people). Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol is scored by autonomous province, so its regional healthcare value is null with a reason: use get_province for Bolzano and Trento. A section a source lacks is null and listed in `missingSections`: report it as missing.

slug.description: A region's slug, e.g. "abruzzo" or "friuli-venezia-giulia", or its name. Find it in a comune's `region` or a province's `regionSlug`.

name: get_region

license.description: License of Expat Living Italy's own work only; upstream data keeps its own license, per dataset.

page.description: The expatliving.it page these figures come from — link it when you quote them.

foreignResidentsAllCitizenships.description: ISTAT's own all-citizenship total (citizenship, not birthplace), summed over the comuni that have one; `coverage` says how many.

coverage.description: How many of Italy's places this dataset covers at all, e.g. 7587 of 7894 comuni.

extractedOn.description: ISO date this value was extracted from the source.

method.description: URL to the methodology page for this dataset.

reason.description: Present only when value is null: why this place has no figure.

vintage.description: The period the value describes, e.g. "2025H2" or "2025" — not when it was fetched.

foreignResidentsByCitizenship.description: Citizenship, not birthplace, and only the citizenships this site tracks, so a floor. Summed over the comuni ISTAT has a row for: `coverage` says how many that is, and a comune with no row adds nothing rather than a zero.

vintage.description: The period the value describes, e.g. "2025H2" or "2025" — not when it was fetched.

layers.description: Every region-grain map layer (healthcare scores) for this region. Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol is scored by autonomous province, so its regional value is null with a reason: look up Bolzano and Trento with GET /province/{code}. Province- and comune-grain layers are not rolled up here.

coverage.description: How many of Italy's places this dataset covers at all, e.g. 7587 of 7894 comuni.

download.description: The whole dataset, as published JSON (every place, with its meta block).

grain.description: The level this value is measured at. Only "comune" is a measurement of this comune itself. "autonomous_province" is Bolzano or Trento, which the source scores on their own rather than as one Trentino-Alto Adige region: the figure belongs to that autonomous province, not to the region.

measuredFor.description: The place the value describes, e.g. "L'Aquila (province)".

method.description: URL to the methodology page for this dataset.

note.description: The source's own coverage caveat, where it has one.

officialZone.description: Only on the seismic hazard layer: the comune's official zona sismica (1 = highest hazard, 4 = lowest). NOTE this runs the opposite way to `value`, which is a hazard class (5 minus the zone). Omitted for comuni that straddle zones.

page.description: The map page for this layer on expatliving.it — link readers here.

scaleNote.description: Only on layers whose scale direction is easy to misread (the seismic hazard class): says which end is which.
